name: Dio
source:
Dio is a mysterious man with a singular sense of style in Zero Escape: Virtue's Last Reward. His comments are often insensitive or downright mean, although whether this comes from intentional malice or simple ignorance was unclear.

[Spoiler]He is actually a part of the terrorist organization Free the Soul's elite group, the Myrmidons. Like all Myrmidons, he is a clone of Left.[/Spoiler]

[From [url=http://zeroescape.wikia.com/wiki/Dio]Zero Escape Wiki[/url]]
